label: verifies identity of
type: subject = a trust store or certificate authority; object = the certificate or party whose identity it validates; means the subject is the authority against which the object's identity claim is checked.
note: Promoted as the certificate family's core predicate. All four occurrences have cert:trust-store as subject and a certificate as object, which is why the pre-round-12 object-only concept metric could not see the trust store at all - this predicate is the reason the promotion metric changed to 'either relation slot' this round.
